title: Control of Datura stramonium in Pepper

Header: Control of Datura stramonium in Pepper
Datura stramonium (Thorn apple) Asefaris, Astenagir (Amharic), Manji, Asangirra (Oromo), Maserba, Thrifra (Tigre)

Prevention: Limit the number of tillage where
Post-harvest tillage may promote survival since seeds become buried
Clean farm tools and machines after leaving an infested area to reduce the risk of spread
Plough the field to expose weed seeds to the sun and birds and/or to bury weed seeds below their germination zone
Remove weeds before seed setting to avoid seed addition to the soil
Apply fertilizer within the crop rows to promote better crop growth
Rotate the crop with pulse crops and cereals to reduce weed pressure
Monitoring: Annual broadleaved bushy herb (0.5–2 m tall); single stem divides into two branches, each of which again divide into two, and so on.
Leaves dark green, with prominent veins; bad-smelling when crushed.
Flowers white to purplish, funnel-shaped and large (up to 100 mm long).
Seed capsules egg-shaped (3– 7 cm long), covered with slender spines
Regular surveillance of crop land, e.g. fortnightly, especially after rain when plants germinate to identify and remove all plants throughout the year
Check fields for infestation during fallow period, before planting and after planting of pepper in order to determine control methods that best suit time and scale of infestation
Critical period of weed competition in pepper is 3 - 8 weeks after transplanting of pepper
Direct Control: Dig, hand pull or hoe out before seed set or cut the plants when the soil is moist to facilitate uprooting, or till the soil when weeds are at seedling stage
To dispose of pulled weed, if seed has not set, add to a compost heap.
If seed has set, ensure pulled weed is burried to least 60 cm
Wear gloves when handling the plants since it is poisonous
Restrictions: Use of chemical herbicides may lead to the development of herbicide resistance.
When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
Glyphosate at 3-4L product/ha during fallow period or before planting crops
Chemical group organophosphate, broad spectrum, systemic, foliage herbicide
